cases.name: Vera Jeannette Badger O'Rafferty
cases.about: She was born in Klamath Falls and lived in Canada for 10 years. She a school bus driver for Mayflower County in Mount Angel. She was a member of the Eagles No. 2081 and the Silverton Square Dance group.
cases.narrative: He shot her in the head and killed her in the parking lot of the Robert Frost Elementary school in Silverton, OR as she was  helping other square dancers load equipment.
